analytics.context: A square panel holding three rising bars. Used for analytics dashboards, insights pages, stats sections, reporting menus and admin overviews.

chart-arrows.context: A chart with one arrow rising and one falling across it. Used for price changes, market movement, gains and losses, variance and comparing ups and downs.

chart-bar-horizontal.context: Bar chart with bars running horizontally from the left axis. Used for rankings, leaderboards, survey results, top-ten lists and comparing categories side by side.

chart-bubble.context: Bubble chart with circles of different sizes placed between two axes. Used for plotting three values at once, market maps, portfolio analysis and data exploration.

chart-donut.context: A donut chart: a ring split into segments of different sizes. Used for shares and proportions, budget breakdowns, storage usage and survey splits.

chart-dots.context: A line chart with a dot marking each data point. Used for trends over time, time series, progress tracking and showing individual measurements along a line.

chart-funnel.context: Funnel chart made of stages that narrow toward the bottom. Used for conversion funnels, sales pipelines, sign-up flows, marketing stages and drop-off analysis.

chart-gantt.context: A Gantt chart of staggered task bars laid along a timeline. Used for project schedules, roadmaps, sprint planning, task dependencies and production timelines.

chart-histogram.context: A histogram of adjoining bars showing how values are distributed. Used for frequency charts, statistics, grade and age spreads, and audio or image level readouts.

chart-radar.context: Radar chart with a data shape drawn inside a pentagon web. Used for skill profiles, product comparisons, player stats, performance reviews and multi-factor scores.

chart-sankey.context: A Sankey diagram showing flows that run between nodes. Used for budgets and cash flow, energy and material flows, user journeys and traffic sources.

chart-scatter.context: Scatter plot of dots placed between two axes. Used for correlation, data exploration, regression, outliers and comparing two measurements.

chart-treemap.context: A treemap: one square divided into nested rectangles of different sizes. Used for disk space usage, portfolio weights, budgets by category and hierarchical data.

chart-waterfall.context: Waterfall chart of floating bars that add up to a total. Used in finance for profit and loss, revenue bridges, budget changes and step-by-step variance.

gauge.context: A round dial gauge with tick marks and a needle. Used for meters, levels, pressure, capacity, scores, health checks and performance readouts on dashboards.

kpi.context: A card with a line rising to an upward arrow, standing for a key performance indicator. Used for metric cards, goals, targets, growth figures and scorecards on dashboards.

report-chart.context: A report sheet with a pie chart above summary lines. Used for business and analytics reports, results summaries, exported statistics and survey reports.

speed-gauge.context: An arched speed dial with its needle swung toward the high end. Used for speed tests, speedometers, performance scores, page load speed and benchmarks.

table-data.context: A data table with a header row above rows and columns. Used for data grids, tabular views, spreadsheets, records lists and switching to a table layout.
